svg.title: Payments platform
svg.script: {"title":"Payments platform","direction":"right","groups":[{"id":"edge","label":"Edge","kind":"tier"},{"id":"core","label":"Payment services","kind":"tier"},{"id":"data","label":"Data","kind":"tier"},{"id":"external","label":"External processors","kind":"boundary"}],"nodes":[{"id":"checkout","label":"Merchant checkout","kind":"client","state":"on","group":"edge"},{"id":"api-gw","label":"API gateway","kind":"gateway","state":"on","group":"edge"},{"id":"payments-svc","label":"Payments service","kind":"service","state":"on","group":"core"},{"id":"fraud-svc","label":"Fraud scoring","kind":"service","state":"on","group":"core"},{"id":"ledger-svc","label":"Ledger writer","kind":"service","state":"on","group":"core"},{"id":"events","label":"Payment events","kind":"queue","state":"on","group":"core"},{"id":"pay-db-primary","label":"Payments DB (primary)","kind":"database","state":"on","group":"data"},{"id":"pay-db-replica","label":"Payments DB (replica)","kind":"database","state":"on","group":"data"},{"id":"fraud-cache","label":"Fraud feature cache","kind":"cache","state":"on","group":"data"},{"id":"stripe","label":"Stripe","kind":"external","state":"on","group":"external"},{"id":"adyen","label":"Adyen (standby)","kind":"external","state":"on","group":"external"}],"edges":[{"id":"checkout->api-gw","from":"checkout","to":"api-gw","kind":"sync","load":0.8,"dependsOn":true,"fallback":false,"label":"HTTPS"},{"id":"api-gw->payments-svc","from":"api-gw","to":"payments-svc","kind":"sync","load":0.8,"dependsOn":true,"fallback":false,"label":"gRPC"},{"id":"payments-svc->fraud-svc","from":"payments-svc","to":"fraud-svc","kind":"sync","load":0.6,"dependsOn":false,"fallback":false,"label":"score"},{"id":"fraud-svc->fraud-cache","from":"fraud-svc","to":"fraud-cache","kind":"sync","load":0.6,"dependsOn":true,"fallback":false,"label":"features"},{"id":"payments-svc->pay-db-primary","from":"payments-svc","to":"pay-db-primary","kind":"sync","load":0.8,"dependsOn":true,"fallback":false,"label":"read/write"},{"id":"payments-svc->pay-db-replica","from":"payments-svc","to":"pay-db-replica","kind":"sync","load":0,"dependsOn":false,"fallback":true,"label":"failover","fallbackFor":"payments-svc->pay-db-primary"},{"id":"pay-db-primary->pay-db-replica","from":"pay-db-primary","to":"pay-db-replica","kind":"replication","load":0.4,"dependsOn":false,"fallback":false,"label":"streaming replication"},{"id":"payments-svc->stripe","from":"payments-svc","to":"stripe","kind":"sync","load":0.7,"dependsOn":true,"fallback":false,"label":"authorize/capture"},{"id":"payments-svc->adyen","from":"payments-svc","to":"adyen","kind":"sync","load":0,"dependsOn":false,"fallback":true,"label":"standby","fallbackFor":"payments-svc->stripe"},{"id":"payments-svc->events","from":"payments-svc","to":"events","kind":"async","load":0.5,"dependsOn":false,"fallback":false,"label":"payment.captured"},{"id":"events->ledger-svc","from":"events","to":"ledger-svc","kind":"async","load":0.5,"dependsOn":false,"fallback":false,"label":"consume"},{"id":"ledger-svc->pay-db-primary","from":"ledger-svc","to":"pay-db-primary","kind":"sync","load":0.4,"dependsOn":true,"fallback":false,"label":"append entries"},{"id":"ledger-svc->pay-db-replica","from":"ledger-svc","to":"pay-db-replica","kind":"sync","load":0,"dependsOn":false,"fallback":true,"label":"failover","fallbackFor":"ledger-svc->pay-db-primary"}],"views":[{"id":"default","type":"topology","direction":"right"}],"scenarios":[{"id":"db-failover","label":"Primary database fails; promote replica","steps":[{"note":"The primary payments database crashes. Services that depend on it degrade onto their standby replica path.","nodes":{"pay-db-primary":{"state":"failed"}},"edges":{}},{"note":"Replica is promoted; traffic is switched to it.","nodes":{},"edges":{"payments-svc->pay-db-replica":{"load":0.8},"ledger-svc->pay-db-replica":{"load":0.4},"payments-svc->pay-db-primary":{"load":0},"ledger-svc->pay-db-primary":{"load":0},"pay-db-primary->pay-db-replica":{"load":0}}},{"note":"Old primary is taken out of service for rebuild; the platform runs fully on the promoted replica.","nodes":{"pay-db-primary":{"state":"off"}},"edges":{}}]},{"id":"processor-outage","label":"Stripe outage; route cards to Adyen","steps":[{"note":"Stripe goes down. Payments service degrades and its standby Adyen path becomes available.","nodes":{"stripe":{"state":"failed"}},"edges":{}},{"note":"Card traffic is routed to Adyen.","nodes":{},"edges":{"payments-svc->adyen":{"load":0.7},"payments-svc->stripe":{"load":0}}}]}]}
